mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods with sustained RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (proxied by INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply-side weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (proxied by PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) increase by more than 10% in a month, it signals strong demand in the housing sector, which has a positive spillover effect on the broader economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 10% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure under tight monetary conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure under tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above 2% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (proxied by GDPC1) grows by less than 1% in a quarter, it signals weak economic growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the quarters where GDPC1 grew by less than 1%.
